title: Mundicuae's Spell Shop
description: A vibrant nighttime festival scene featuring a purple-skinned elf wizard with a crown, laughing while holding a glowing green potion bottle. He stands behind a decorated market stall filled with magical items, an open spellbook, lit candles, coins, a glass cloche containing red butterflies, floating lanterns, and theatrical masks.
prompt: A cheerful purple-skinned elf wizard wearing a crown and cream robes stands behind a festive market stall at night. He holds up a glowing green potion with one hand while laughing. The stall is covered in purple and teal cloth, an open spellbook, scattered gold coins, red candles, and a large glass cloche with red butterflies inside. Floating purple and red paper lanterns hang above, theatrical masks and potion bottles fill the shelves behind him, magical sparkles and green banners complete the lively celebration atmosphere.
